request: Activate the complete Kalaxy3 SAGE mandatory operating contract. Require current Git, GitHub, SAGE, and runtime authority before mutation; evidence-based selection and reuse of repository-owned components; composition manifests; capability-gap receipts; real runtime validation; failure diagnosis that records what failed, what should have been done, which existing component should have been used, why the actual path differed, and the reusable correction; measurable outcome, reuse, authority, failure, rework, and safety statistics; Git credential and history safety; and an operator-executed, visible, one-boundary-at-a-time Git/GitHub mutation gate. Downloaded implementation helpers may edit and validate repository files but may only inspect Git read-only and may not create or switch branches, stage, commit, push, pull, merge, rebase, reset, clean, delete refs, mutate GitHub, or deploy.
required_capability: Construct semantic outcome reports from explicit raw measurements and compare only compatible workflow classes.

candidates_considered.insufficiency: Aggregates primitive event counts but does not validate the operating-contract raw metric set, derive semantic rates, preserve unknowns as null, or construct comparable trends.

gap.missing_interface_or_behavior: A typed metrics primitive that validates all raw fields, derives only transparent rates, separates authoritative and fixture mutations, and rejects incomparable trends.
gap.why_configuration_is_insufficient: Configuration cannot add the missing semantic validation and trend contract to usage.summary.
gap.why_composition_is_insufficient: Composition can invoke aggregation but cannot supply schema-level formulas, null semantics, or comparability enforcement.

proposed_primitive.responsibility: Construct semantic outcome reports and comparable trends from explicit raw measurements.
proposed_primitive.side_effects: in-memory report and trend construction only
proposed_primitive.idempotency: deterministic for fixed raw measurements, provenance, timestamps, and baseline reports
proposed_primitive.logging: caller records report identifier, source references, metric availability, and digest without raw secrets
proposed_primitive.failure_mode: missing raw fields, invalid values, opaque scoring, or incomparable trends fail closed

approval.rationale: Approved as the ninth gap in the operating-contract component and gap plan.
